source: demo-rig:invoice.extract (synthetic invoice, fictional company, no personal data)
prompt:
Extract the invoice below into the required JSON structure. Money fields are numbers without currency symbols. `line_item_count` is the number of distinct line items. `payment_terms_days` is the integer number of days in the payment terms (e.g. Net 30 -> 30).

INVOICE (synthetic):
Invoice number: INV-2026-0042
Date: 2026-07-15
Bill to: Northwind Traders
Line items:
  1. Widget Pro license  — quantity 3, unit price 120.00
  2. Onboarding session  — quantity 1, unit price 250.00
Subtotal: 610.00
Tax (8%): 48.80
Total due: 658.80
Currency: USD
Payment terms: Net 30
